gloss: entirely; completely; in bulk; all at once

definitions.gloss: entirely, completely, in bulk, all at once
definitions.explanation: Describes a large quantity being taken, removed, or disappearing at once. Often implies surprise or emphasis on the amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ごっそり⟦{消|き}えた→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ごっそりなくなって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The contents of the fridge were completely gone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貴重品|きちょうひん}→貴重品：15344_kichouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ごっそり⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧いかれた。
examples.english: The thief made off with all the valuables.

notes:
ごっそり is an expressive adverb meaning that a large quantity is removed, taken, or gone all at once. It has an onomatopoeic quality that suggests bulk removal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ごっそり⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧: to take everything away
- ごっそり⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧: to fall out in clumps (especially hair)
- ごっそりなくなる: to disappear completely
- ごっそり⟦{盗|ぬす}まれる→盗む：01166_nusumu⟧: to have everything stolen
- ごっそり⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧: to decrease drastically

USAGE:
Almost always describes loss, removal, or disappearance. Carries a tone of surprise at the amount affected. Informal — not used in formal writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧: completely (neutral, broader usage)
- ごっそり emphasizes bulk quantity and is more dramatic/vivid than ⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧
